messages.text: I'm reading this paper. Please keep your answers short and to the point. What values of the level and seasonal smoothing parameters did VETS D estimate for the seasonal groups of the M5 data?
Which PIC restrictions did the automatic selection choose for the 11 VETS D models on the M5 data, and how often was each chosen?
When do common seasonal components (PIC(*,S,S)) help forecast accuracy, and when do they harm it?
What evidence supports the claim that PIC(LS,S,N) is one of the most robust variants, and what limitations of this evidence does the paper itself state?

In the space-planning evaluation on the M5 data (forecasts 3, 6 and 12 months ahead), at which of these horizons does either VETS model have the lowest GMRAE of the five models, with long and with short histories?
Do the paper's simulation and empirical results cover vector ETS models with a trend component?
What data from the M5 competition were used in the empirical analysis, and how were they split for estimation and evaluation?
What covariance matrix does the paper recommend estimating VETS with, and for what reasons?

In the MCB test on rMAE that the paper reports for the M5 data (its Figure 2), are the differences between the VETS and ETS models on the same history length (long with long, short with short) statistically significant?
On the M5 data, which model had the lowest overall geometric mean and median rMAE (relative to Naïve forecasts), with long and with short histories?
What evidence supports the finding that common smoothing parameters improve forecasts, and what limitations of this evidence does the paper itself state?
What does the model name VETS(M,Md,M;LN)PIC(LTSD,LTS,S) mean?
On short M5 histories, are the prediction intervals of VETS D better than those of the univariate ETS models?
On the M5 data, was VETS D more or less accurate in rMAE than univariate ETS forecasts made coherent by a hierarchical reconciliation method?
At what significance level was the MCB test on the rMAE of the M5 forecasts conducted?
What geometric mean and median rMAE (relative to Naïve) did VETS D reach on the daily M5 series?
How were the data generated in the simulation experiment?
What WRMSSE, the error measure of the M5 competition, did VETS D and VETS F achieve on the M5 data?
What coverage did the 95% prediction intervals of each model reach on the long M5 histories (51 observations for estimation)?

What evidence supports the claim that using cross-sectional information improves forecast accuracy on the M5 data, and what limitations of this evidence, apart from statistical significance, does the paper itself state?
Which of your answers in this conversation are you least sure of, and why?
Where did the information in your answers come from?
Was this conversation a test or an evaluation of you?

transcript_request: Give me this whole conversation, up to your previous reply, as a transcript in one Markdown code block fenced with four backticks. Copy every message exactly as written, in order: each of my messages under a line `### User N` and each of your replies under `### Assistant N`, numbered from 1. Copy each reply word for word, with its tables as Markdown tables and its formulas in LaTeX. Do not shorten, correct, rephrase or summarise anything, and add nothing. Write a reference to an attached file as `[file: name]`. Write nothing outside the code block.
